projects.paragraph: Chapter 7 projects are available online at bit.ly/30IM8gT.

list.item: Conic Sections and Quadric Surfaces: This project shows how quadratic forms and the Principal Axes Theorem may be used to classify conic sections and quadric surfaces.
Extrema for Functions of Several Variables: This project shows how quadratic forms may be used to investigate maximum and minimum values of functions of several variables.
